n1.text:
You are in Chorsu Bazaar. You smell fresh bread. A seller smiles at you.

What do you do?

n2a.text:
You buy warm bread. Delicious! Suddenly it starts to rain.

Where do you go?

n2b.text:
You ask an old man: «Where is the metro?» He points left. You walk and see a small park.

What next?

n3a.text:
In the café you meet a tourist who needs help with English. You practice together. Great day!

🏁 The end — +XP for curiosity!

n3b.text:
Under the roof you share bread with a student. You talk about school. New friend!

🏁 The end — +XP for kindness!

n3c.text:
On the bench you open your notebook and learn 5 new words. Peaceful and smart!

🏁 The end — +XP for focus!

n3d.text:
You find the metro and go home on time. Practical and confident!

🏁 The end — +XP for independence!

s1.text:
You have a job interview in 30 minutes. Your phone shows heavy traffic.

What do you do?

choices.label: Call and say you may be late

s2a.text:
The manager appreciates your honesty. You arrive 10 minutes late but calm.

In the interview they ask: Why do you want this job?

choices.label: I want to learn and grow

s2b.text: You arrive sweaty but on time. The first question: Tell us about yourself.

s3a.text:
They smile. You get a second interview. Success path!

🏁 End — professional communication wins.

s3b.text:
They look unsure. Maybe next time with better answers.

🏁 End — practice interview phrases!
